formalization.project_name: Matrix multiplication exponent at most 9/4 over arbitrary fields

mathematical_sources.note: Supplies the original 9/4 construction, complex-field proof, and arithmetic specification. This project extends that proof to arbitrary fields. The collective attribution follows the upstream repository; no endorsement by upstream authors is claimed. Historical priority for field-independence arguments has not been established.
mathematical_sources.title: An Upper Bound of 9/4 for the Matrix Multiplication Exponent

mathematical_sources.note: Five Brouwer proof modules are vendored with the compatibility patch inherited from OpenAI, the module-system port, and explicit proof arguments required by the new elaborator. The original MIT notice is preserved under lean/FixedPointTheorems/LICENSE.txt. See UPSTREAM.md.
mathematical_sources.title: Fixed-point theorems in Lean 4
